create_ViT_backbone: create a Vision Transformer backbone with configurable depth, embed_dim, and window attention blocks
build_SimpleFeaturePyramid: build a simple feature pyramid on top of a ViT backbone with configurable scale factors and output channels
create_ViT_block: create a transformer block with window attention, relative positional embeddings, and residual conv block support
create_attention_block: create a multi-head attention block with relative position embeddings and qkv projections
calculate_ViT_lr_decay: calculate learning rate decay rate for ViT parameters based on layer id and base decay rate
